items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: like the Ted Baxter of jazz

ctx.x: I still do some radio work. I work at Sirius Satellite Radio and I do their — I forget what it’s called, like liners or interstitial, you know like “you’re listening to pure jazz” that kind of stuff. So I still do that, and it’s fun, like the Ted Baxter of jazz.
Where do you record that kind of stuff?
